name: Darbhanga Municipal Corporation
jurisdiction: Darbhanga Municipal Corporation area in Darbhanga Sadar subdivision, Darbhanga district
populationApprox: 296,039 (2011 Census figures for the wards in the Bihar SEC final ward formation register)
description: Darbhanga district identifies this body as its municipal corporation, separate from Benipur Municipal Council. The Bihar State Election Commission's final ward formation register lists 48 wards.
